description: Tier 0 Bring-Bloch K-search for the proton effective volume. Searches for ℤ-linear combinations of hyperbolic volumes in the Tier 0 set {4_1, 5_2, 6_1, 6_2, 6_3, 7_4, 𝓑₃, L_6a4, 8_11, Whitehead} equaling Vol(K_p^eff) = λ_p_scale · 8·G, where λ_p_scale is either the CODATA-closure value (2.4599527843613) or the C2-inflection value (2.4616, PR #690 substrate-pure). Per prop:bring-hyperbolic-knot-bloch-decomposition (on main, sorry-free conditional Lean), an integer relation in B(F)⊗ℚ with F ⊆ ℚ(ζ_60) is the categorical identity for λ_p_scale.

Vol(K_p^eff)_CODATA.source: implied λ_p from CODATA m_p with Vol(𝓑₃) = 8G
